title: 第14章 门禁被打裂了？！
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: “给你看？”叶凛把手里的廉价软皮本往怀里一揣。开什么国际玩笑。这上面写的是什么？是《西游记》全本大纲。是这只猴子未来五百年的悲惨“劳改”生涯。从被压五指山喝铜汁铁丸，到戴上紧箍咒给那个只会念经的秃驴当保镖。再到一路上给各路神仙坐骑擦屁股受窝囊气。要是现在给这只还处于“老子天下第一”中二期的猴子看了，他绝对会当场暴走。这蟠桃园能不能保住另说。这猴子要是直接杀上西天把如来佛祖的莲花座给掀了，那整个东方神话的时间线就全乱套了。蝴蝶效应懂不懂？叶凛虽然是个临时工，但也不想当那个把历史车轮给卸了的罪人。“不行。”叶凛拒绝得斩钉截铁。“这是付费内容。”孙悟空挠了挠腮帮子，金箍棒在手里转了个圈，发出呼呼的风声。“付费？你是说钱？”猴子一脸鄙夷。“俺老孙去东海龙宫拿定海神针都没付钱，去地府改生死簿也没掏过这玩意儿，看你个破本子还要钱？”“小气。”孙悟空哼了一声，倒也没上手抢。毕竟隔着那道看不见的屏障，他也抢不着。他把金箍棒往地上一插，也不嫌地上凉，盘着腿就坐了下来。那双火眼金睛上下打量着叶凛，像是要把这个奇怪的凡人看出一朵花来。“不过话说回来。”孙悟空身子前倾，那张毛脸几乎贴在透明的空气墙上，呼出的热气在屏障上晕出一小团白雾。“你这凡人，胆子是真肥。”“俺老孙这一路走来，也遇到过不少其他世界来的和你一样的凡人，他们也都认识我。”“谁见了俺老孙那都是战战兢兢，一口一个‘大圣’，一口一个‘孙爷爷’。”“怎么到了你这儿，就成了‘猴先生’？”孙悟空歪着头，探究的看着叶凛。“咋的？真不认识俺齐天大圣？”叶凛把圆珠笔帽盖上。他把本子塞进屁股底下垫着，这才慢条斯理地剥开一颗瓜子。“认识啊。”“花果山水帘洞美猴王，齐天大圣孙悟空。”“名头挺响，如雷贯耳。”叶凛把瓜子仁扔进嘴里，嚼得嘎嘣脆。“但这跟我有什么关系？”孙悟空一愣。这回答他没听过。“我是来打工的，又不是来追星的。”叶凛拍了拍手上的瓜子皮屑，一脸的理所当然。“你又没给我发工资，也不是我直属领导，更不是我爹妈。”“我为什么要对你点头哈腰？”“就因为你能打？”叶凛嗤笑一声，端起茶缸吹了吹漂在上面的枸杞。“别逗了猴先生，我和你说的那些凡人不同，我可是完完整整的上完了学的。”“我的价值观告诉我，神明并不万岁，人人平等。”“大家都是第一次做碳基生物，谁比谁高贵啊。”叶凛这番话，说得那叫一个云淡风轻。但在孙悟空听来，却无异于一道惊雷在耳边炸响。猴子那双总是滴溜溜乱转的眼睛此刻罕见地定住了。他看着叶凛。这个凡人身上没有半点法力，瘦得像根豆芽菜，仿佛一阵风就能吹倒。但他坐在那个破马扎上的姿态，却比那凌霄宝殿上端坐的玉帝还要稳当。那是刻在骨子里的不卑不亢。他没有撒谎。“人人平等……”孙悟空喃喃自语，咀嚼着这几个字。自从他学艺归来，闯龙宫、闹地府，求的不就是个不受管束。不就是个“平起平坐”吗？但这天庭里的神仙，表面上对他客客气气，背地里谁不是叫他“泼猴”、“妖怪”？那种骨子里的傲慢和歧视，孙悟空哪怕是成了齐天大圣，也依然能感受得到。可眼前这个凡人不一样。他是真的没把神仙当回事。在他眼里，自已这个齐天大圣，和那些天兵天将，似乎没什么区别。这种感觉……真他娘的爽！“哈哈哈哈！”“好！好一个谁比谁高贵！”“你小子，对俺老孙的胃口！”孙悟空用力拍着大腿，震得身上的锁子黄金甲哗哗作响。“俺老孙跳出三界外，不在五行中，逍遥自在！”叶凛眼睛一亮：“猴先生，冒昧问一句——你有房贷吗？”“水帘洞天生地养，哪来主人收俺老银钱？”“那车贷呢？”“筋斗云一个跟头十万八千里，何来借一说？”“下一代？”“石头缝里蹦出来的，上无老下无小！”“五险一金总有吧？”孙悟空挠头：“五险一金……是啥？”叶凛一听，肃然起敬：“懂了，跳出三界，不在五行不是真逍遥，你这才是真逍遥——”“跳出三贷，不在五险之中。”孙悟空被捧得舒坦，咧嘴笑：“你这凡人说话怪有趣，比太上老君炼丹炉里的道经好听多哩！”“就冲你这句话，你这个朋友，俺老孙交了！”叶凛淡定地喝了口水。“交朋友可以，借钱免谈。”“还有，别拍大腿了，猴毛都扬我茶杯里了。”孙悟空也不恼。他往地上一躺，双手枕在脑后，翘着二郎腿，看着头顶上那些诱人的大蟠桃。“哎，你说这天庭是不是有病？”话匣子一打开，这猴子的吐槽属性瞬间觉醒。“俺老孙刚上天那会儿，玉帝老儿封了我个弼马温。”“我还以为多大的官呢，结果就是个养马的！”“这也就算了，好歹手底下还有几千匹天马归我管。”“现在倒好，封了个齐天大圣，说是官居极品，结果呢？”“有官无禄！”孙悟空愤愤不平地拔了一根狗尾巴草叼在嘴里。“连个蟠桃会都不请我！”“这蟠桃园就在俺老孙府邸旁边，结果想吃个桃子还得看你这破门禁的脸色。”“这分明就是把俺老孙当猴耍！”叶凛听着猴子的抱怨，心里暗笑。这就是典型的职场PUA啊。先给个虚名把你稳住，然后不给实权，不给福利，还得让你感恩戴德。玉帝这老小子，玩弄权术确实有一套。“这就是大公司的通病。”叶凛适时地插了一句嘴，充当起了知心大哥哥。“官僚主义严重，层级冗余，晋升通道堵塞。”“你看那玉帝，天天坐在上面画大饼，说什么‘位列仙班’、‘长生不老’。”“实际上呢？”“脏活累活全是底层干，福利分红全是高层拿。”“最重要的是，你们连假期都没有。”“你这齐天大圣，听着好听，其实没编制，没五险一金，连个年终奖都没有。”“纯纯的白嫖。”孙悟空听得一愣一愣的。虽然不太懂什么叫“五险一金”，什么叫“年终奖”。但“白嫖”这两个字，他听懂了。太形象了！太贴切了！“没错！就是白嫖！”孙悟空一拍大腿，激动得差点跳起来。“这玉帝老儿，太不地道！”“俺老孙这一身本事，就被他这么晾着！”一人一猴，隔着一道屏障，竟然聊出了几分惺惺相惜的味道。叶凛一边附和着猴子的吐槽，一边不动声色地把话题往自已关心的方向引。“话说回来，猴先生。”叶凛给孙悟空递过去一把瓜子。这次孙悟空学聪明了，迅速抓住，没给叶凛收回去的机会。“最近我们那个世界，好像不太太平。”“好多你们这边的……嗯，同事，都跑到我们那边去了。”“说是叫什么神话复苏。”“你知道这事儿吗？”孙悟空嗑瓜子的动作一顿。他吐出瓜子皮，一脸茫然。“神话复苏？那是啥？”“俺老孙天天在这天庭里待着，除了喝酒就是睡觉，没听说谁下凡了啊。”孙悟空挠了挠头。“不过……”他像是想起了什么。“最近这天庭里，确实有点怪。”“总有一些奇奇怪怪的人，像你一样，突然冒出来，又突然消失。”“前两天俺老孙在兜率宫门口，还看见一个穿着叫什么……西装的人，想偷老君的仙丹。”“结果被金角银角给扔进八卦炉里炼了。”叶凛手一抖，差点把茶缸给摔了。好家伙。看来自已不是唯一的“打工人”。那个穿西装的哥们儿也是个狠人，敢去偷太上老君的家？这是嫌命长啊。“至于你说的什么复苏……”孙悟空摇了摇头。“可能是那些高高在上的大人物们在布什么局吧。”“反正跟俺老孙没关系。”“俺只要有架打，有酒喝，管他去哪儿呢。”叶凛心里稍微有点失望。看来这猴子现在的级别还不够高，接触不到这种核心机密。或者是被玉帝他们有意隐瞒了。不过也正常。现在的孙悟空在天庭高层眼里，就是个不稳定的炸弹，谁会把战略计划告诉他？而且按照后期发展，哪怕孙悟空成了斗战胜佛，似乎也就是个打手头头。就在这时。叶凛手腕上的那块廉价电子表发出“滴滴滴”的报警声。八小时。到了。【叮！任务时限已到。】【恭喜宿主完成“蟠桃园安保”任务。】【正在进行绩效结算……】【强制下班程序启动。】叶凛长舒了一口气。终于下班了。这一天天的，跟这帮神仙打交道，比在写字楼里写PPT还累。他站起身，拍了拍屁股上的灰，把小马扎折叠起来。“行了，猴先生。”“我下班了。”“咱们有缘再见。”孙悟空正嗑瓜子嗑得起劲，见叶凛要走，顿时有点意犹未尽。这天庭里好不容易碰到个能说话、还能跟他一起骂玉帝的妙人。这就要走了？“哎哎哎，别急着走啊！”孙悟空站起身，扒着屏障喊道。“再聊五毛钱的！”“俺老孙还没跟你说完那托塔李天王的糗事呢！”“而且……”孙悟空看了一眼那满园子的蟠桃，又看了一眼准备撤退的叶凛，眼珠子一转。“你这活儿干完了，这门禁是不是就撤了？”“那俺老孙是不是就能进去了？”叶凛把“替天行道”的大茶缸挂在腰带上，回头冲着孙悟空咧嘴一笑。“想得美。”“我……”叶凛的话还没说完。异变突生。原本那道稳如泰山、连如意金箍棒都砸不动的透明屏障。突然像是接触不良的老旧电视屏幕一样。闪烁了一下。滋啦——空气中传来一声令人牙酸的电流声。一道肉眼可见的裂纹，从屏障的中心处崩裂开来。就像是一块完美的玻璃，被一颗石子击中了要害。叶凛脸上的笑容僵住了。孙悟空也愣住了。一人一猴大眼瞪小眼。下一秒。一股浓郁到化不开的蟠桃香气，顺着那道裂缝，疯狂地涌了出来。直冲孙悟空的天灵盖。猴子的喉结剧烈滚动了一下。那双原本已经平静下来的火眼金睛，瞬间再次燃起了金色的火焰。他看着叶凛，嘴角勾起一个让人毛骨悚然的弧度。那不是笑。是野兽看到了猎物，囚徒看到了打开的牢门。
content_en: "Show it to you?" Ye Lin put the cheap soft-cover book in his arms.What an international joke.What is written on this?It is the complete outline of "Journey to the West".This is the monkey’s miserable “re-education through labor” career for the next five hundred years.From being forced to drink copper juice and iron pills from Wuzhishan, to wearing a tight spell and acting as a bodyguard for that bald donkey who can only chant sutras.Then, along the way, I wiped the butts of various immortal mounts and felt cowardly.If you show this monkey who is still in the second stage of "I am the best in the world" now, he will definitely go berserk on the spot.Whether the Pantaoyuan can be saved is another matter.If this monkey directly kills the Western Heaven and lifts the lotus seat of Tathagata Buddha, then the entire timeline of Eastern mythology will be completely messed up.Do you understand the butterfly effect?Although Ye Lin is a temporary worker, he doesn't want to be the sinner who unloaded the wheels of history."No." Ye Lin refused firmly."This is paid content." Sun Wukong scratched his cheek and turned the golden hoop in his hand, making a whirring sound."Pay? You mean money?" Monkey looked disdainful."My old grandson didn't even pay for the Poseidon Needle when he went to the Dragon Palace of the East China Sea. He didn't even pay for it when he went to the underworld to change the book of life and death. Do you think you want more money for your poor book?" "Stingy." Sun Wukong snorted, but he didn't grab it.After all, he couldn't grab it through that invisible barrier.He thrust the golden cudgel into the ground and sat down with his legs crossed even if the ground was cold.Those fiery eyes looked Ye Lin up and down, as if trying to see this strange mortal into a flower."But then again." Sun Wukong leaned forward, his furry face almost pressed against the transparent air wall, and the hot breath he exhaled created a small cloud of white mist on the barrier."You mortal, you are so courageous." "I, Old Sun, have met many mortals like you from other worlds along the way, and they all know me." "Everyone who meets me, Old Sun, is trembling with fear. They say 'Great Sage' and say 'Grandpa Sun'." "How come I have become 'Mr. Monkey' when I get here?" Sun Wukong tilted his head and looked at Ye Lin inquiringly."What? You really don't know me, the Monkey King?" Ye Lin capped the ballpoint pen.He stuffed the notebook under his buttocks and slowly peeled open a melon seed."I know you." "The Monkey King of the Water Curtain Cave in the Flower and Fruit Mountain, the Monkey King, the Monkey King." "The name is very loud, like thunder." Ye Lin threw the melon seeds into his mouth and chewed them until they were crunchy."But what does this have to do with me?" Sun Wukong was stunned.He hadn't heard this answer."I'm here to work, not to chase stars." Ye Lin patted the melon seed rinds on his hands with a matter-of-fact expression."You didn't pay me a salary, and you're not my direct boss, let alone my parents." "Why should I nod and bow to you?" "Just because you can fight?" Ye Lin sneered, picked up the teapot and blew on the wolfberries floating on it."Don't be ridiculous, Mr. Monkey. I'm different from the mortals you mentioned. I went to school completely." "My values ​​​​tell me that gods are not long live, and everyone is equal." "This is the first time for everyone to make carbon-based organisms, who is nobler than others." Ye Lin's words were so calm and gentle.But to Sun Wukong's ears, it was like thunder exploding in his ears.The monkey's eyes, which were always moving around, were rarely fixed at this moment.He looked at Ye Lin.This mortal had no magic power at all and was as thin as a bean sprout, as if he could be blown over by a gust of wind.But the way he sat on that broken horse was more stable than the Jade Emperor sitting upright in the Lingxiao Palace.That is neither humble nor arrogant engraved in the bones.He didn't lie."Everyone is equal..." Sun Wukong murmured to himself, chewing on these words.Ever since he came back from studying arts, he went to the Dragon Palace and made trouble in the underworld, all he wanted was to be left alone.Isn’t it just an “equal”?But the gods in heaven were polite to him on the surface, but secretly they called him a "monkey" and a "monster"?That kind of arrogance and discrimination in his bones, Sun Wukong can still feel it even if he becomes the Monkey King.But the mortal in front of him was different.He really didn't take gods seriously.In his eyes, there seems to be no difference between himself, the Monkey King, and those heavenly soldiers and generals.This feeling... is so damn good!"Hahahaha!" "Okay! Who is more noble than the other!" "You boy, you have an appetite for my grandson!" Sun Wukong slapped his thigh hard, making the chained golden armor on his body rattle."My old grandson has jumped out of the Three Realms, is not in the Five Elements, and is free and at ease!" Ye Lin's eyes lit up: "Mr. Monkey, I would like to ask - do you have a mortgage?" "Shuiliandong was born to raise money, how can the owner accept my money?""What about the car loan?" "Somersault cloud has traveled thousands of miles, how can we borrow it?" "The next generation?" "Those who jumped out of the cracks in the rocks, no one is old, no one is young!" "There are always five insurances and one fund, right?" Sun Wukong scratched his head:"What are the five insurances and one gold..." Ye Lin was awestruck when he heard this: "I understand, if you jump out of the three realms and are not in the five elements, you are not really free. You are really free -" "If you jump out of the three loans, you are not in the five dangers." Sun Wukong wasHolding it comfortably, he grinned: "You, a mortal, talk very interestingly, much better than the Taoist scriptures in the alchemy furnace of Taishang Laojun!" "That's what I say to you, you are my friend!" Ye Lin calmly took a sip of water."It's okay to make friends, but no need to talk about borrowing money." "Also, don't slap your thighs, the monkey hair is flying into my teacup." Sun Wukong was not annoyed either.He lay down on the ground, put his hands behind his head, crossed his legs, and looked at the attractive large peaches above his head."Hey, do you think this heaven is sick?" As soon as the conversation started, the monkey's complaining attribute was instantly awakened."When I, Sun, first ascended to heaven, the Jade Emperor granted me the title of Bi Ma Wen." "I thought I was a big official, but it turned out that I was a horse breeder!" "Forget it, at least I still have thousands of Pegasus horses under my control." "It's better now, I was granted the title of Monkey King, saying that I was the best official, but what's the result?" "I have an official but no salary!" Sun Wukong angrily pulled out a dog's tail grass and held it in his mouth."You didn't even invite me to a peach party!" "This peach garden is right next to my grandson's mansion, but if you want to eat a peach, you have to look at your face for breaking the rules." "This is obviously treating me like a monkey!" Ye Lin listened to the monkey's complaint and laughed inwardly.This is a typical workplace PUA.First, I will give you a false name to stabilize you, and then I will not give you real power or benefits, and I will make you grateful.The Jade Emperor, this old boy, does have a way of playing tricks of power."This is a common problem in large companies." Ye Lin interrupted at the right time, acting as a close brother."The bureaucracy is serious, the hierarchy is redundant, and the promotion channels are blocked." "Look at the Jade Emperor, who sits on it every day and draws pie, talking about 'ranking in the immortal class' and 'immortality.'" "What's the reality?" "The dirty work is all done by the bottom, and the benefits are shared in dividends.It's all from the top management.""The most important thing is that you don't even have a holiday." "It sounds nice to you, Monkey King, but in fact you have no establishment, no five insurances and one gold, and you don't even get a year-end bonus." Sun Wukong was stunned when he heard this.Although I don’t quite understand what “five insurances and one housing fund” are and what “year-end bonus” is.But he understood the word "prostitution for free".So vivid!So apt!"That's right! It's free prostitution!" Sun Wukong slapped his thigh and almost jumped with excitement."This old man, the Jade Emperor, is so unkind!" "My old grandson is just showing off his talents like this!" One person and one monkey, separated by a barrier, actually talked with a bit of sympathy.Ye Lin echoed the monkey's complaints while calmly steering the topic in the direction he cared about."Speaking of which, Mr. Monkey." Ye Lin handed Sun Wukong a handful of melon seeds.This time Sun Wukong learned the lesson and caught it quickly without giving Ye Lin a chance to take it back."It seems that our world is not peaceful recently." "Many of your... um, colleagues have gone to our side." "It's called the revival of mythology." "Do you know this?" Sun Wukong paused while eating melon seeds.He spat out the melon seed rinds with a confused look on his face."Myth resurrected? What is that?" "My old grandson stays in this heaven every day, except for drinking and sleeping. I have never heard of anyone descending to earth." Sun Wukong scratched his head."But..." He seemed to remember something."It is indeed a bit strange in heaven recently." "There are always some weird people, like you, who suddenly appear and disappear." "Two days ago, my old grandson was at the gate of Tushita Palace. I saw a man wearing a suit called... and wanted to steal the old man's elixir." "In the end, he was thrown into the Bagua furnace for refinement with gold and silver horns." Ye Lin shook his hand and almost dropped the teapot.Good guy.It seems that I am not the only "worker".That guy in the suit is also a ruthless man. How dare he steal the Supreme Lord's house?This is too long a life."As for the recovery you are talking about..." Sun Wukong shook his head."Maybe those high-ranking big shots are setting up something." "It has nothing to do with me anyway." "As long as I have a fight and a drink, I don't care where he goes." Ye Lin felt a little disappointed.It seems that the monkey's current level is not high enough to have access to such core secrets.Or maybe it was deliberately concealed by the Jade Emperor and others.But it's normal.Sun Wukong is now an unstable bomb in the eyes of the higher-ups in Heaven.
